startFailed.permissions: Grant background location access to start

mapUnavailable.body: Map unavailable: the Google Maps key is missing from .env.

detail.empty: Register the first one to begin
detail.regions: {{total}} regions with the system · GPS idle

empty.title: No companies yet
empty.body: Draw the perimeter on the map and mark out the rooms.

editor.deleteBody: Delete "{{name}}" and all of its rooms? Events already recorded stay in the log.
editor.derivedHint: Derived from the perimeter. The circle wakes the app; the polygon decides entry.
editor.outlineRedrawHint: The rooms must remain inside the new perimeter.

errors.outlineExcludesRooms: The new perimeter would leave a room outside. Widen the shape or delete the room first.

rooms.title: Rooms ({{total}})
rooms.explainer: Native circles do not work at this scale, so rooms are polygons.

outline.title: Company perimeter
outline.body: Drag the map until the pin sits on a corner and tap "Add point".

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.body: Each internal area becomes a named polygon.
rooms.emptyBody: You can finish without any and add them later.

roomDraw.title: Room perimeter
roomDraw.body: The blue outline is the company. The room has to fit inside it.

noPosition.title: No position
noPosition.body: Check the permission and that location services are on.

errors.name: Enter a name with at least 2 characters
errors.area: The area came out too small (minimum {{total}} m²)
errors.outsideCompany: The room has to sit inside the company perimeter
errors.roomName: Enter a name with at least 2 characters
errors.selfIntersecting: The outline crosses itself. Tap "Untangle" or undo the last points.
errors.tooClose: That point sits on top of another one. Pan the map before adding it.

tangled.title: The outline crosses itself
tangled.body: The corners came out of order. A crossed outline makes the area and the detection wrong.
tangled.hint: Check it on the map: the same points admit more than one shape.

wizard.savedButNotMonitoring: Company saved, but monitoring did not start. Check the permissions in Settings.

simulator.title: Simulator
simulator.intro: Plays a synthetic route through the same pipeline the GPS feeds. Verifies detection from your desk.
simulator.accuracyHint: Above 100 m the reading is discarded.
simulator.footnote: Positions are dated backwards, so real monitoring can carry on right after.

crossing.label: Walk through
crossing.hint: Enters, crosses the rooms and leaves the far side

approach.label: Arrive and stay
approach.hint: Enters and remains at the centre

monitoringWarning.title: Real monitoring is running
monitoringWarning.body: Stop monitoring on the Monitor tab for a clean test.

welcome.title: Geofence Lab
welcome.body: Draw your company's perimeter and the rooms inside it. The app tells you when you enter and leave each one.

how.title: How it works
how.body: Two tiers, to spare the battery.
how.bullet1: The system watches nearby companies and wakes the app.
how.bullet2: Only then does the GPS start, to tell which room you are in.
how.bullet3: On the way out it stops. At rest, no position is requested.

location.title: Always-on location
location.body: The system asks for ordinary access first, then background. On Android the second opens a settings page — pick "Allow all the time".
location.resultHint: Without it, detection only works while the app is open. You can grant it later.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Every entry and exit becomes a local notification. Works offline.

company.title: Register your company
company.body: Mark on the map where it is.
company.bullet1: A fixed pin marks each corner.

backgroundMissing.title: No background access
backgroundMissing.body: The system only asks once. After that, only through the device settings.

battery.title: Battery optimisation
battery.body: Some manufacturers kill the service with the screen off. Exempting the app avoids that.

reset.title: Erase everything
reset.body: Erases companies, rooms, events and the message sequence.

delivery.title: Delivery confirmation
delivery.hint: Every delivered message POSTs to this URL. Generate one at webhook.site to try it.
delivery.invalid: Enter an http:// or https:// URL, or leave it empty to disable.

messages.title: Messages
messages.intro: Onboarding minutes after signup, then one message a day at a fixed hour. Offline, with retry.
messages.permissionDenied: Without notification permission there is nothing to schedule

notEnrolled.title: Not enrolled
notEnrolled.body: The whole plan derives from the signup instant.

receipts.title: Delivery confirmations
receipts.noEndpoint: No endpoint in .env. The queue is still recorded.
